items.text:
The idea is awesome. But....
Be aware that Blue Bottle (devs) actively censor reviews and conversation on their "games" They will delete even the slightest negative comment or what they deem negative.

Don't support companies who cannot handle constructive criticism.

Its been over 5 years and they are hung up on niche UI overlays, and making sure your gender identity is represented in a game where you can hardly even see your character details other then they are humanoid, due to the pixel style...

Dev priorities are confused, don't waste your time, its half baked and on maintenance mode.
items.text_zh:
这个想法很棒。但是……
请注意，Blue Bottle（开发者）会积极审查他们“游戏”上的评论和对话。他们会删除哪怕是最轻微的负面评论，或者他们认为负面的内容。

不要支持那些无法接受建设性批评的公司。

已经过去5年多了，他们还在纠结于小众的UI覆盖层，并确保你的性别认同在一个由于像素风格而几乎看不清角色细节（除了他们是人形）的游戏中得到体现……

开发者的优先事项混乱，别浪费时间，这游戏半生不熟，处于维护模式。

observations.description: 开发重点放在小众UI覆盖层上
observations.evidence: they are hung up on niche UI overlays
observations.evidence_zh: 他们纠结于小众的UI叠加层
